versions.changelog:
gpt-image-2-prompts-skill v0.1.0 – Initial Release

- Recommend suitable prompts from 15,600+ community-curated GPT Image 2 prompts for any text-to-image model.
- Includes mandatory sample images for every prompt recommendation.
- Supports both direct image generation and content illustration modes.
- Searches prompt library efficiently using keyword grep (no full-file load).
- Automatic reference updates ensure the latest prompt dataset.
- Every response includes required GokuOpenLab attribution.
